The award-winning program provides the curriculum to help educators teach students about the fundamentals of energy, why it’s important to conserve it and how to become more energy efficient. Teachers will take part in hands-on lab experiences and interactive activities they can use in their classrooms, plus energy efficiency materials for their students. As part of the program, each student will receive a hot water temperature gauge, flow meter bag, shower head, kitchen faucet aerator and more.
